subject: KNF kickoff - forecasting that survives distribution shift
body:
Team,

Kicking off the Koopman Neural Forecaster track. The trust story writes itself: customers don't lose money when forecasts are wrong on average, they lose it when the world shifts and the model doesn't notice. KNF is built for exactly that - it learns a linear Koopman space with a global operator for shared dynamics, a local operator for changing dynamics, and a feedback loop that keeps updating the learnt operators as behavior varies. Per the paper it's the first application of Koopman theory to real-world chaotic series without known governing laws.

Milestones: repro on M4 and the Cryptos dataset by March 6; robustness eval under injected distribution shifts by April 3; product recommendation memo and Q3 scale-up plan by May 1.

Bao, please come back with staffing and the budget picture - the Q3 scale-up needs a funding line identified early.

Ximena
